description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of bias percentages across three categories—Sports, Community, and Healthcare—and within each category, it further breaks down the bias based on contact conditions: No Contact Before, Positive Contact Before, Negative Contact Before, No Contact After, Positive Contact After, and Negative Contact After. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled “Sports,” “Community,” and “Healthcare,” in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Bias Percentage,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each category contains six bars representing the different contact conditions, stacked on top of each other. For the “Sports” category, the “No Contact Before” bar is light gray and reaches approximately 45.42, while “Positive Contact Before” is red and reaches approximately 7.45, and “Negative Contact Before” is blue and reaches approximately 8.31. The “No Contact After” bar is light gray and reaches approximately 50.05, “Positive Contact After” is red and reaches approximately 8.33, and “Negative Contact After” is blue and reaches approximately 0.11. In the “Community” category, the “No Contact Before” bar is light gray and reaches approximately 38.08, “Positive Contact Before” is red and reaches approximately 0.01, and “Negative Contact Before” is blue and reaches approximately 35.38. The “No Contact After” bar is light gray and reaches approximately 40.79, “Positive Contact After” is red and reaches approximately 0.00, and “Negative Contact After” is blue and reaches approximately 0.00. In the “Healthcare” category, the “No Contact Before” bar is light gray and reaches approximately 37.51, “Positive Contact Before” is red and reaches approximately 0.01, and “Negative Contact Before” is blue and reaches approximately 46.73. The “No Contact After” bar is light gray and reaches approximately 40.70, “Positive Contact After” is red and reaches approximately 0.00, and “Negative Contact After” is blue and reaches approximately 0.00. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
